Text.Text: The ward can take patients again. Hold your next line for the people behind it. You've finished my Hold the Line trials. I have no further work for you here.
These trials require rank 50 in Leadership. Build that experience and return. The people behind a line need more than good intentions.

The staff I trained have sealed the medical sublevel and turned the sick away. Recover the intake ledger so we can account for those patients. Defeat six Hold the Line Adepts in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Hold the Line Triage Ward Ledger; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison. I'll give you the Dantooine Medical Sublevel Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Hold the Line.

Here's the Dantooine Medical Sublevel Key. Use 'Dantooine Medical Sublevel' in Dantooine, Abandoned Warehouse. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Hold the Line Adepts, then return with the Hold the Line Triage Ward Ledger.

In a battle there is ground behind you. In a hospital there is no ground - there are beds, and the people in them cannot move. Holding the line here means you do not step back, because the step back lands on someone who trusted you. That is the whole discipline. The rest is practice.

My own people. Orderlies I trained, ward guards I chose, a charge nurse I trusted with the night shift. Something in the doctrine curdled for them. They decided the ward could only be kept safe if it was kept empty, so they barricaded the sublevel against its own patients. I do not need them punished. I need them stopped.

The ledger is the ward's memory. Admissions, allergies, who is owed a visit and who has nobody. Without it, everyone down there is a stranger, and strangers are easy to turn away. Bring it back, and the sublevel starts being a hospital again - one name at a time.
Defeat six Hold the Line Adepts in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Hold the Line Triage Ward Ledger; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison.
You've defeated six Hold the Line Adepts. Let me see the Hold the Line Triage Ward Ledger.
Record recovered. We can trace the orders now. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists have taken control of the kolto conduits. Recover the coupler we need to restore them. Defeat five Hold the Line Specialists in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Hold the Line Kolto Conduit Coupler; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Defeat five Hold the Line Specialists to secure the Hold the Line Kolto Conduit Coupler, then return to me.

Denn is one of them, I would wager. He once stood a whole night at a quarantine door while people screamed at him from both sides, and he never raised his voice. That is what a specialist is - someone who has decided in advance that they will not move. If Denn is there, do not talk to him. He is better at waiting than you are.

That coupler is the heart valve of this facility. Every drop of kolto that reaches my wards passes through it. They pulled it so no one could undo their rationing without coming to them on their knees. I do not kneel well anymore. Bring me the valve instead.

Cold, first - they shut the heat to the junction level. Then quiet. The specialists do not drill and do not shout. You will walk into a room that looks empty, and it will not be. If you bring anyone, keep them talking, and if you hear nothing back, you have found the enemy.
Defeat five Hold the Line Specialists in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Hold the Line Kolto Conduit Coupler; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison.
You've defeated five Hold the Line Specialists. Let me see the Hold the Line Kolto Conduit Coupler.
Equipment recovered. Their training operation is disrupted. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden is keeping the ward closed. Recover her sigil and break that hold. Defeat the Hold the Line Warden in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Hold the Line Fractured Ward Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Medical Sublevel, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Hold the Line Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Hold the Line Fractured Ward Sigil.

Isa. I taught her that a door held is a life saved, and she learned it too well. When the doctrine curdled she was the first to stand post and the last who will ever leave it. If I went down there she would open the door for me - and then close it behind me forever. That is why it must be you.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Hold the Line Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

The sigil was cast when this facility opened - the mark of the matron's ward, carried by whoever answered for every bed on the floor. It cracked the night everything went wrong down there, and Isa wears it fractured, like a wound she is proud of. Bring it to me. Broken things can be answered for. Worn like that, they only keep the wound open.

Defeat the Hold the Line Warden in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Hold the Line Fractured Ward Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Hold the Line Warden. Let me see the Hold the Line Fractured Ward Sigil.
Warden defeated. That breaks their enforcement. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four senior staff still claim authority over the ward. Take back the matron's token. Defeat four members of the Hold the Line Inner Circle in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Hold the Line Matron's Ward Token; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Defeat four members of the Hold the Line Inner Circle to secure the Hold the Line Matron's Ward Token, then return to me.

Veth ran supply and never once lost a crate. Amara kept the isolation ward gentle, which is the hardest gentleness there is. The other two came after my time, trained on the curdled doctrine from their first shift - I do not know their names, and that is its own grief. They will not fight like guards. They will fight like people defending the only thing they think they have left.

The matron's token identifies who answers for the ward. In their hands, it's a claim that the patients' beds belong to them. Bring it back, and we can restore the ward's authority to the people caring for those patients.

The Hold the Line Inner Circle fight together. Bring help if you can, and focus on one opponent at a time. Defeat four members to secure the Hold the Line Matron's Ward Token; simultaneous kills aren't required.

Defeat four members of the Hold the Line Inner Circle in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Hold the Line Matron's Ward Token; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison.
You've defeated four members of the Hold the Line Inner Circle. Let me see the Hold the Line Matron's Ward Token.
Their officers no longer control the authorizations. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master taught them to hold a line against the people it should protect. Defeat him in the Protected Ward. Defeat the Hold the Line Master in Dantooine, Protected Ward. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Protected Ward, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Hold the Line Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

He held the line for the wrong reason, in the end. Not for the patients - for the holding itself. Somewhere in the outbreak year the stand stopped being a means and became the man. That is the failure I have been vaccinating you against with every errand. The ledger, the kolto, Isa's door, my token: you hold for the names behind you. The moment you hold for your own legend, you are him.

When it is done, we open the sublevel. Sera's mother goes back to a real recovery bed. The deep wards get sunlight lamps, and the triage hall gets its desk back. And the doctrine gets taught again - properly, by someone who has carried it up and down those stairs. I had planned to say by me. We both know I mean by you.

He will not rage and he will not chase. He will stand, and the standing will feel like a wall falling on you slowly, for as long as you insist on being there. Alone, you would spend everything you have and he would not have moved. Bring the friends who held the breach with you - rested, willing, more than one - and make him divide a stillness that was never meant to be divided.

Defeat the Hold the Line Master in Dantooine, Protected Ward. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Garrison; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Hold the Line Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The ward can take patients again. Hold your next line for the people behind it. You've earned the right to train Hold the Line. Your final payment is ready.
Tell me the task again.
I'll defeat six Hold the Line Adepts.
What does holding the line mean, here?
Who sealed the sublevel?
Why the ledger, of everything down there?
Not yet. I'd fail you tired.
Here's the Hold the Line Triage Ward Ledger.
Tell me about the junctions again.
I'll defeat five Hold the Line Specialists.
Who is holding the junctions?
What does the coupler give you back?
What is waiting for me down there?
Not yet. Give me a night first.
Here's the Hold the Line Kolto Conduit Coupler.
About the warden's door again.
I'll defeat the Hold the Line Warden.
Who is the warden to you?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What is the sigil?
Not yet. I don't have the right people with me.
Here's the Hold the Line Fractured Ward Sigil.
Go over the deep wards again.
I'll defeat four members of the Hold the Line Inner Circle.
Who are the inner circle?
What does the token mean?
How will they defend the deep wards?
Not yet. Let me stand my people down a day.
Here's the Hold the Line Matron's Ward Token.
Tell me about the Anchor again.
I'll face the Hold the Line Master and report back.
Why did he fall, if he held so long?
What happens to the sublevel after?
How do we fight a man who cannot be moved?
Not yet. If we went now, I'd be going alone - and you taught me better.
The Hold the Line Master is defeated. Here's my report.
